description: Source code for the MAX31875 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register access, configuration, and sensor data handling.

methods.name: max31875_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the MAX31875 sensor over I2C.

methods.name: max31875_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register of the MAX31875 sensor over I2C.

methods.name: set_config_flags
methods.description: Sets specific flags in the sensor's configuration register.

methods.name: max31875_update_config
methods.description: Updates the sensor's configuration register with new settings.

methods.name: max31875_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: max31875_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the latest temperature sample from the sensor.

methods.name: max31875_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the temperature value as a sensor_value structure.
